detail: Findings: Similarity is a weak substitute for explicit dependency links: best-case hit@10 is 30% among ~1,500 candidates (40x chance, still 70% miss). Dependency archaeology should ride the depends_on graph (validated at write since 1.24.0), not retrieval — supports #30/#31 design direction and the graph_reachability weight.; Semantic's real edge is coverage, not ranking: 0% hard-miss vs keyword's 5-8% — it degrades gracefully on paraphrase where keyword blanks entirely. Low-overlap briefing outliers (J=0.23-0.48) all had sparse keyword arms.; Briefing composition impact shrinks with corpus scale and summary richness: mean Jaccard 0.72-0.75 on field repos (25% of briefing differs by mode) vs 0.43 on twining-mcp's smaller corpus. Material but not dominant — hint-level investment confirmed as right-sized; chunking remains unjustified.
summary: Retrieval A/B on 3 corp repos: semantic beats keyword at dependency retrieval (hit@10 30/25 and 14/7, zero hard-miss) but both weak absolutely; briefing overlap 0.72-0.75 at field scale.
